transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for about a year and eight months now. I just can't seem to shake this persistent low mood, and I really need some help.
During this period, have you ever had times lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more talkative or impulsive than usual?
No, I've never had times like that. I've mostly just felt really down, depressed, and completely exhausted instead. There hasn't been any period where I felt energized or euphoric.
Over these 1 year and 8 months, have you felt depressed most of the day on more days than not, or have there been stretches of 2 months or longer when you felt mostly okay?

No, there haven't been any breaks or stretches where I felt okay. I've felt depressed and sad almost every single day for the entire year and eight months. It has just been a continuous, daily struggle without any relief.
During this time, have you also had symptoms like losing interest in things, changes in sleep or appetite, poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of death or suicide?

My sleep is completely ruined; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly, have bad nightmares, and feel exhausted even if I sleep excessively. However, I haven't experienced any changes in my appetite, loss of interest, trouble concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of suicide.
Before this current 1 year and 8 month period, did you ever have another separate episode lasting at least 2 weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No, I don't recall ever having another separate episode like this in the past. Before this started, I hadn't experienced anything like what I've been going through these last 20 months.
How much has this depression affected your daily functioning, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?
I'm not really sure how to describe the impact on my daily life, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how to put it into words, other than just trying to get through each day.
Besides the low mood and sleep problems, have you had low energy, low self-esteem, poor concentration, hopelessness, or changes in appetite during this 1 year and 8 months?

No, I haven't really experienced any of those issues during this time. My energy, self-esteem, and concentration have been okay, and I don't feel hopeless or have changes in my appetite. It has really just been the low mood and the sleep problems.
Even if you wouldn’t call it loss of interest, have things you usually enjoy felt less pleasurable or emotionally flat most days during this period?

Yes, I've been feeling incredibly emotionally flat and numb lately. It feels like my emotions are completely dulled or even paralyzed, leaving me with a constant sense of emptiness. It's just really hard to feel much of anything at all anymore.
Did these symptoms start after a traumatic event, and do the nightmares or emotional numbness seem tied to reliving or avoiding reminders of that event?
I don't think these symptoms started after any specific traumatic event. I'm not really sure what triggered them, and they don't seem to be tied to any kind of trauma.
During this 1 year and 8 months, was there ever a period of at least 2 weeks when the low mood and emotional numbness were clearly worse than usual and present nearly all day, every day?

Actually, it hasn't just been a brief two-week period where things got worse. This low mood and emotional numbness have been present nearly all day, every day, for the entire year and eight months. It has just been one continuous, persistent struggle the whole time.
